incidents.name: BarnBridge abandoned-governance takeover
incidents.notes: The attacker acquired about 43% of the inactive BarnBridge DAO's voting power and legitimately passed a proposal changing CompoundProvider's controller to attacker code, whose authorized calls swept users' lingering USDC allowances.

sources.ref: trace identifies 0x66c6f3b4b4b458e6d764759ecf122484ebef7580 as attacker-deployed controller infrastructure and the pre-existing CompoundProvider 0xdaa037f99d168b552c0c61b7fb64cf7819d78310 as the governed victim; victim creator 0x378a9c9c44b41c0e8970c358470e4e72eb782302
